item.title: Bursar Street smelling of pee and littering of glasses, cans and foodwaste, 17th August
item.description:
I am a resident near Bursar Street, with 2 rooms directly facinig the alley way oof Bursar Street. I am sure others have made similar complaints but there have been so many instances at night where people either pee or vomit along this alley way and it just reeks of pee/vomit. People also have been dumping bottles, glasses, cans and food after drinking and eating in this alleyway. The smell is exceptionally bad during summer. Pleasse can this be looked at regularly.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Bursar Street, The Borough, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
